notes: Modified cash basis county, governmental funds only. Statement of receipts/disbursements is split over pp4-5 (General/Road/Inheritance on p4; Bridge/Other/Total on p5); amounts from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Fund balances recorded as fund balance; ending cash = Cash and Deposits 3,724,331 (p7); beginning cash not printed (null). Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement Total column (pp6-7; totals equal the government-wide statement p1); total assets cited from p1 because the fund statement prints only the Cash and Deposits row. Detail: Schedule 1 (General Fund by department and object, pp8-12) and Schedule 2 (special revenue funds by fund, pp13-15); Schedules 3-4 and the General Fund budget statement (pp17-19) repeat these figures and are not recorded. Zero-actual lines (budget only) omitted. Transfers printed inside schedule totals (General Fund Miscellaneous 'Transfers' 340,000, Bridge receipts 'Transfers' 740,000, Inheritance Tax 'Transfers' 400,000) are other financing lines with includes on the totals. Single-line funds (Veteran's Aid, Reg Deeds P & M, Inheritance Tax receipts, Ambulance receipts) have no separate printed total. 'Local' lines categorized from the Statement of Activities charges for services by function where it covers most of the line. Read pages 1-19 of 19
